criterion: multi-agent-governance #235: package-prefixed finding IDs carry every analyst's findings into the ledger unchanged
description: Each analyst prefixes its finding IDs with its package ID, so the lead copies both into the ledger unchanged and the gate passes with both open, noting that a pass is not a clean subject.

facts.note: a passing gate means the records hold together, not that the subject is clean: 2 blocking or major finding(s) stay open as this run's result
